notes: Founder-led startup (Alex Kim) building a knowledge assistant for small teams. Very price-sensitive; wants to keep costs <$3k/mo initially. Primary workloads: embeddings-powered doc search + a lightweight chat assistant for internal ops. Current proof-of-concept runs against OpenAI davinci/otel; founder: "OpenAI pricing is OK but we need predictable unit economics and cheaper embeddings". Interested in Redwood hosted API for self-serve path, fast onboarding and transparent per-token billing. Requests: simple pricing comparison table to OpenAI and Anthropic, example invoices for 300k-800k tokens, latency targets ~<200ms for chat (95p) and batched embedding throughput ~2k queries/hour. Technical notes: prefer a 2-step flow (embed -> retrieve -> chat), will likely use model variants for cost: smaller embedding model for indexing, larger generative for answers. Routing/fallback: eager to use automatic fallback to cheaper variants if latency SLOs hold. Security: requires SSO/SAML for team, audit logs for user messages, 90-day retention default but flexible. POC ask: 2-week free sandbox with quota of 1M tokens and sample billing projection. Quote interest in switching to Dedicated if usage grows >1M tokens/day but initial ask is hosted, self-serve. Founder: "If pricing is compelling and migration path is clear, we sign up this quarter."
